## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- Shared Docker container name — `videomax-postgres` was already owned by another worktree; the healthy Postgres service was reused on port 5433.
- Contract fixture arithmetic — six named fixtures plus 50 bulk users is 56 users, despite the API-LIST-05 sentence specifying total 55. The criterion was verified against the prior 55-user baseline; all named fixtures and bulk fixtures were preserved for UI/E2E coverage.
